definitions.matching: per car at 50-200 m, the scored SECOND candidates (evaluation mask) before NMS, in descending SECOND score, each take the nearest unmatched car within 2 m (metrics._match)
definitions.radar_rescue: SECOND score < SECOND threshold, CLOCs-R score >= CLOCs-R threshold, winning cell is a radar cell
definitions.camera_suppression: SECOND score >= SECOND threshold, CLOCs-R score < CLOCs-R threshold, winning cell is a camera cell or the reserved cell
definitions.no_proposal: no scored SECOND candidate within 2 m, and a D2 box of score >= 0.1 within 2 m
definitions.lidar_points: inside the car's 3D box enlarged by 0.5 m on every side
definitions.radar_returns: last 5 sweeps with Doppler motion correction (D2's input), inside the BEV box enlarged by 0.5 m
definitions.width_px: width of the car's projected 3D box, clipped to the image; 0 if not projectable
definitions.after_nms_check: not part of the event rule: whether a final detection (after NMS) of score >= threshold lies within 2 m of the car, for SECOND and CLOCs-R
